multiEndpoint.observed: Seven real Endpoint rows rendered as one list. The first row had no top border and rows 2-7 each had exactly one computed solid top separator; no bottom borders created double lines.

narrow820.observed: At innerWidth 820, the 1040px row grid remained inside a 600px overflow-x auto container; all six separators remained present without page-level row compression.

singleEndpoint.observed: A temporary renderer-only reduction to one Endpoint produced no orphan top or bottom separator.

emptyEndpoint.observed: A temporary renderer-only reduction to zero Endpoint rows left no Endpoint separator. The DOM mutation was not persisted and a reload restored the real settings.
